elements.label: Figure 3.4
elements.title: As countries develop, they build the basics of compliance capacity, broaden the coverage of their standards, and increasingly follow a balanced approach involving the private sector
elements.content:
Scope of coverage of standards (y-axis arrow pointing up) vs Development trajectory (x-axis arrow pointing right).

Phase 1: Basics
- Description: Build basic quality infrastructure and focus governmental quality assurance on high-stakes areas.
- Public sector box contains: Standards, Testing and certification, Metrology, Accreditation.
- Private sector box contains: Private sector indicator.

Phase 2: Broaden
- Description: Increase coverage of standards, expand quality infrastructure, and leverage private quality assurance.
- Public sector box contains: Standards, Testing and certification, Metrology, Accreditation.
- Private sector box contains: Private testing and certification.

Phase 3: Balance
- Description: Fully transition to a public-private partnership model for compliance.
- Public sector box contains: Standards, Testing and certification, Metrology, Accreditation, Market surveillance.
- Private sector box contains: Private testing and certification.

Source: WDR 2025 team.
